payload.description: Each data asset and the one system that masters it. An asset with no line has no system of record, which is a finding about the estate, not a gap in the drawing. Who else reads or writes it is the table and the per-asset view.
notes: 45 entities on an architecture diagram. Past about 40 this has become a landscape: narrow the scope, or mark it `kind: map`.
payload.title: Systems of Record
